flags.why: Quyến means very thin, fine silk, with no defining black colour or glossy finish ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/quyến)).
The common meaning 'matte; non-glossy', used for cosmetics and finishes, is missing ([example usage](https://comem.vn/son-li)).
flags.fix: adj | matte; non-glossy; ex: Tôi thích loại son này vì màu đẹp và chất son lì. = I like this lipstick because the colour is beautiful and the finish is matte.

flags.why: 'Nằm lì' means remaining in bed persistently, whereas 'stuck in bed' suggests being unable to get out.
flags.fix: He stayed in bed all Sunday.

flags.why: 'Sầm cao hơn' is not natural Vietnamese and treats a Sino-Vietnamese element as a freely usable adjective.
flags.fix: Remove this example and omit the flashcard unless an authentic example of this restricted sense is available.

flags.why: 'Một ngọn sầm' is not natural Vietnamese and teaches the learner to use a Sino-Vietnamese element as an ordinary word for a hill.
flags.fix: Remove this example and omit the flashcard unless an authentic example of this restricted sense is available.
